mcp_protocol.tools_list_pagination: cursor-based, no hard page-size limit; server determines page size

resources.context_window_contribution: injected as plain input-token message content by host on resources/read; NOT counted as tool-definition tokens
resources.notes: No spec-enforced count or size limit. Cost is incurred at read time, not at list time.

prompts.context_window_contribution: returned messages array injected verbatim as input tokens by host; NOT counted as tool-definition tokens
prompts.notes: No spec-enforced count or size limit. Prompt templates are typically small; embedded resource content can be large.

elicitation.schema_constraint: flat objects with primitive-only properties (string, number, integer, boolean, enum); nested objects and arrays-of-objects explicitly NOT supported
elicitation.rate_limit: clients SHOULD implement rate limiting; no numeric cap in spec

sampling.status: deprecated as of 2026-07-28 draft; new implementations should not adopt
sampling.notes: No token/count limits applied; was a pass-through to host model

mcp_protocol.notes: Protocol enforces no hard message-size limit. All count/size ceilings are enforced by the client or model-API layer.

cursor.timeout_notes: Community reports ~60 s; feature request open; no official value documented
cursor.notes: Beyond ~40 tools, extras are silently dropped from model view

claude_desktop.timeout_notes: Hardcoded ~60 s; 'timeout' field in claude_desktop_config.json is currently ignored (as of 2026-06)
claude_desktop.agent_loop_notes: Per-turn tool-use limit exists; triggers 'reached its tool-use limit' message; numeric cap undocumented

claude_code_cli.timeout_default_notes: Default ~28 h; configurable via MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT env var or per-server 'timeout' field in .mcp.json
claude_code_cli.agent_loop_max_turns: unlimited (SDK default); server-side ~20 tool-call guardrail (pause_turn) as of ~March 2026

vscode_github_copilot.notes: 128-tool cap applies in Agent mode; tool timeout undocumented

m365_copilot.notes: 10 actions per declarative agent; 45 s plugin I/O budget; 4,096-token plugin I/O token budget

mcp_typescript_sdk_v2.notes: resetTimeoutOnProgress now defaults to true (parity with Python SDK)

mcp_python_sdk.notes: No default timeout historically; see python-sdk#1374

openai_agents_sdk.turn_definition: one LLM invocation; tool executions do not increment counter

anthropic_agent_sdk.server_side_guardrail: ~10 iterations / ~20 tool calls (stop_reason=pause_turn); server-enforced, cannot be overridden
anthropic_agent_sdk.error_on_exceed: error_max_turns (if max_turns set); otherwise pause_turn stop_reason

serving_stack_open_weight.binding_limit: max_model_len / KV-cache — operator-configured; no vendor-fixed number
serving_stack_open_weight.default_context_pitfall: vLLM default max-model-len often 16K, which silently truncates tool calls mid-generation
serving_stack_open_weight.tool_call_timeout: no built-in timeout; limited by request timeout in serving framework (e.g. vLLM --request-timeout)
serving_stack_open_weight.agent_loop_max_turns: framework/SDK dependent; model layer has no cap
serving_stack_open_weight.notes: No tool-count cap at model layer. Context window set by --max-model-len. Tool calling requires --tool-call-parser matching the model family.

anthropic.prompt_cache_ttl_ordering_rule: longer TTL entries MUST precede shorter TTL entries
anthropic.rate_limit_meter: ITPM (input tokens per minute) — only UNCACHED input tokens count
anthropic.tool_call_timeout_notes: No model-API level timeout; enforced by client (Claude Desktop ~60 s hardcoded)

schema_micro_limits.compiled_grammar_limit: 400 error when compiled grammar too large (complex schemas with optional params, union types, nested objects)

anthropic.agent_loop_default_turns: unlimited (SDK); ~20 tool calls server-side guardrail (pause_turn stop_reason, ~March 2026)

prompt_cache_ttl.in_memory: 5-10 min inactivity; max 1 h; available on all models except gpt-5.5 and newer
prompt_cache_ttl.extended_24h: up to 24 h; default for gpt-5.5/gpt-5.5-pro and all future models; available for gpt-5.x, gpt-4.1

openai.rate_limit_meter: TPM (input + output) — cached tokens STILL count toward TPM

schema_micro_limits.strict_mode_enum_notes: large enum sets increase latency; no hard cap published

prompt_cache_implicit.notes: Automatic; no code changes; cost savings passed through automatically

google_gemini.rate_limit_meter: RPM + TPM (combined input+output); implicit cache effect on rate limit undocumented

schema_micro_limits.notes: API rejects very large or deeply nested schemas with error; no numeric limit published. Simplify schema on error.

xai_grok.prompt_cache_notes: undocumented in Tier-1 sources as of 2026-06-21

mistral.prompt_cache_notes: undocumented in Tier-1 sources as of 2026-06-21

microsoft_copilot.prompt_cache_notes: undocumented; product-layer; underlying model (GPT-5.x) caching may apply via Azure
